entries.title: Proverbs 17:1
segments: ¶Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than a house full of feasting [with] strife.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:2
segments: ¶A wise servant shall rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part in the inheritance among the brethren.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:3
segments: ¶The fining-pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but Jehovah trieth the hearts.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:4
segments: ¶The evil-doer giveth heed to iniquitous lips; the liar giveth ear to a mischievous tongue.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:5
segments: ¶Whoso mocketh a poor [man] reproacheth his Maker; he that is glad at calamity shall not be held innocent.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:6
segments: ¶Children's children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:7
segments: ¶Excellent speech becometh not a vile [man]; how much less do lying lips a noble!

entries.title: Proverbs 17:8
segments: ¶A gift is a precious stone in the eyes of the possessor: whithersoever it turneth it prospereth.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:9
segments: ¶He that covereth transgression seeketh love; but he that bringeth a matter up again separateth very friends.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:10
segments: ¶A reproof entereth more deeply into him that hath understanding than a hundred stripes into a fool.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:11
segments: ¶An evil [man] seeketh only rebellion; but a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:12
segments: ¶Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man rather than a fool in his folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:13
segments: ¶Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:14
segments: ¶The beginning of contention is [as] when one letteth out water; therefore leave off strife before it become vehement.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:15
segments: ¶He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the righteous, even they both are abomination to Jehovah.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:16
segments: ¶To what purpose is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing [he] hath no sense?

entries.title: Proverbs 17:17
segments: ¶The friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:18
segments: ¶A senseless man striketh hands, becoming surety for his neighbour.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:19
segments: ¶He loveth transgression that loveth a quarrel; he that maketh high his gate seeketh destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:20
segments: ¶He that hath a perverse heart findeth no good; and he that shifteth about with his tongue falleth into evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:21
segments: ¶He that begetteth a fool [doeth it] to his sorrow, and the father of a vile [man] hath no joy.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:22
segments: ¶A joyful heart promoteth healing; but a broken spirit drieth up the bones.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:23
segments: ¶A wicked [man] taketh a gift out of the bosom, to pervert the paths of judgment.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:24
segments: ¶Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:25
segments: ¶A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bore him.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:26
segments: ¶To punish a righteous [man] is not good, nor to strike nobles because of [their] uprightness.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:27
segments: ¶He that hath knowledge spareth his words; and a man of understanding is of a cool spirit.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:28
segments: Even a fool when he holdeth his peace is reckoned wise, [and] he that shutteth his lips, intelligent.
